description: Get a Korean legal reference value verified by Lifelaw (라이프로), such as the statutory interest rate, minimum wage or lease renewal request period, with its legal basis (article), verification date and start date of effect, labelled in Korean and English. Find keys with list_params.

date.description: Show whether it is in force on this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today

key.description: Item key (lowercase, dot-separated). E.g. rates.civil, minWage.2026

name: get_param
title: Legal reference values (기준 수치)
